messages:
maria: Hey team — I need someone to cover the Sunday 06:00–10:00 PDT oncall block. Flight changed, won't make it. There's a scheduled cache flush at 06:30 and a rolling kernel patch at 07:15 (no downtime expected but please monitor). If nobody claims, I can try to remote but prefer a swap. @alex @priya any chance? :pray:

alex: I can take 06:00–08:00 but have a hard stop at 08:00. I can stay as shadow until 09:00 if needed. I'll grab handoff notes.

sam: I can cover 08:00–12:00, so alex+sam covers 06:00–12:00. Priya, can you take 09:00–10:00 overlap so we have warm handover? :thumbsup:

priya: I can do 09:00–11:00, happy to overlap 09:00–10:00. I'll check the runbook for the cache flush. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/cache-flush

maria: Awesome — thanks @alex @sam @priya. Handoff notes:
- Scheduled tasks: cache flush 06:30 (monitor redis replication lag), kernel rolling patch at 07:15 (watch rolling restarts; alert if >10% error rate).
- Quick checks: ```kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference || echo no-pods``` and health endpoint: ```curl -fsS https://api.redwood.prod/health || true```
- If 95th latency > 300ms for >5min, escalate to eng-runtime oncall (pager: @eng-runtime).
- Dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics?panel=latency&range=1h

alex: noted. I'll post my pre-shift handoff 15m before 06:00 with any open issues.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window starts 2026-03-22 07:15 UTC for kernel rolling patch. See https://status.redwood/maintenance/12345

sam: I'll add a short handoff doc in #eng-oncall-docs with open items and links to traces if anything spikes.

maria: TY all. I'll update the rota and ping People Ops for coverage record.

priya: all set from me.

alex: on it. :rocket:
